# Clean the main brushes

[All care guides](README.md)

## Roomba 600 and 700 series

![Clean the main brushes](../img/underside_600_900--main_brush.svg)

**What it does**

The main brushes lift dirt from carpet and hard floor into the bin. Hair wound round them makes them slip and pick up less.

**How to**

1. Turn the robot over onto a soft surface.
2. Lift the two yellow tabs of the brush frame and take out the bristle brush and the beater brush.
3. Pull off the end caps and remove hair and thread from the ends and the axles.
4. Put the end caps back, put each brush back where its shape fits and close the frame.

> **Note** The two brushes are not alike and fit only one way round. Do not force them.

## Roomba 800 and 900 series

![Clean the main brushes](../img/underside_600_900--main_brush.svg)

**What it does**

The main brushes lift dirt from carpet and hard floor into the bin. Hair wound round them makes them slip and pick up less.

**How to**

1. Turn the robot over onto a soft surface.
2. Squeeze the yellow tabs of the brush frame and fold the frame up.
3. Take out both rubber rollers, pull off the end caps and remove hair from the square and hexagonal pegs.
4. Put the end caps back, put each roller back where its peg fits and close the frame until it clicks.

> **Note** The two brushes are not alike and fit only one way round. Do not force them.

## Roomba e, i and j series, Combo j

![Clean the main brushes](../img/underside_eij--main_brush.svg)

**What it does**

The main brushes lift dirt from carpet and hard floor into the bin. Hair wound round them makes them slip and pick up less.

**How to**

1. Turn the robot over onto a soft surface.
2. Press the release button next to the brushes and open the brush frame.
3. Take out both rubber rollers, pull off the end caps and remove hair from the ends and the axles.
4. Put the end caps back, put each roller back where its shape fits and close the frame.

> **Note** The two brushes are not alike and fit only one way round. Do not force them.

## Roomba s series

![Clean the main brushes](../img/underside_s--main_brush.svg)

**What it does**

The main brushes lift dirt from carpet and hard floor into the bin. Hair wound round them makes them slip and pick up less.

**How to**

1. Turn the robot over onto a soft surface.
2. Press the button on the right of the cleaning head: the latch lifts.
3. Take out both rubber rollers, pull off the end caps and remove hair from the ends and the axles.
4. Put the end caps back, put the rollers back where their shape fits and close the latch.

> **Note** The two brushes are not alike and fit only one way round. Do not force them.

## Prime robots and other models

![Clean the main brushes](../img/underside_eij--main_brush.svg)

**What it does**

The main brushes lift dirt from carpet and hard floor into the bin. Hair wound round them makes them slip and pick up less.

**How to**

1. Turn the robot over onto a soft surface.
2. Open the brush frame by its release tabs and lift both brushes out.
3. Pull off the end caps and remove hair and threads from the ends and axles. Cut wound hair along the groove.
4. Put the end caps back, insert each brush where its shape fits, and close the frame.

> **Note** The two brushes are not alike and fit only one way round. Do not force them.
